Test fixture: coastline layers clipped to the Cove Island test box (~186 KB), used by the
Lab's GSHHG vs Natural Earth mask comparison test.

- `ne_10m_*.json`: Natural Earth 1:10m land, minor islands and lakes. Public domain
  (https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/).
- `gshhg/`: GSHHG (Global Self-consistent, Hierarchical, High-resolution Geography Database),
  Wessel & Smith. Distributed under the GNU Lesser General Public License (LGPL) v3 or later
  (https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/pwessel/gshhg/). This clip is an unmodified subset of the
  original shapes, kept here only as test data.
